kurz: Falafel are made from soaked but raw chickpeas: their starch binds only in the hot oil. Cooked chickpeas fall apart.
bild_im_kopf: Like the rim of a sandcastle that only firms up in the sun: shaped damp and loose, it holds only through the heat.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Soak dried chickpeas overnight, do not cook them
schluesselmomente.warum: Raw starch [[quellen|swells]] only in the frying and then holds everything together. Cooked chickpeas are already too soft.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Grind coarsely with onion, garlic, herbs and spices
schluesselmomente.warum: Ground coarsely, the balls stay light and fluffy inside.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Chill the mixture for 30 minutes, then shape
schluesselmomente.warum: Cold mixture is easier to shape and holds together in the oil.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fry at about 175 °C until deep golden brown
schluesselmomente.warum: The heat cooks the raw chickpeas through and forms the crisp crust.
